name: Bathurst Metals Corp.
summary: Bathurst Metals Corp., an exploration stage company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada. It explores for gold, silver, lead, zinc, copper, nickel, cobalt, platinum, and palladium deposits. The company holds interests in the Turner Lake property comprising 3,500 hectares; Gela Lake project covering an area of 2,400 hectares; and McAvoy Lake project consisting of 2,700 hectares located in Nunavut, Canada. It also has interests in the McGregor Lake property comprising 11 mineral claims covering approximately 13,125 hectares; and TED Project, which covers an area of 2,644 hectares located in western Nunavut, Canada. The company was formerly known as Pacific Cascade Minerals Inc. and changed its name to Bathurst Metals Corp. in August 2020. Bathurst Metals Corp. was founded in 2006 and is based in Gibsons, Canada.
